outcomes.outcome: Execute and Monitor Automated Test Runs
outcomes.description: Configure test scenarios, browsers, authentication, and execution mode, then launch and monitor Playwright test runs. Includes stopping runs mid-execution and recovering from stale run state.

scenarios.description: QA Engineer selects a non-localhost test scenario, chooses a browser and headless preference, optionally provides OIDC session credentials, and submits the run to the server. The dashboard streams live logs, shows a status badge, and polls the server for completion to determine report availability.

actions.action: Select the test scenario
actions.description: label: Test Scenario; type: enum; required: true; default: Breezeai sanity dev; options: Breezeai sanity dev, Breezeai sanity prod, Breezeai complete regression dev, AccionConnect sanity dev, AccionConnect sanity prod; disabled while a test is in progress

actions.action: Select the browser
actions.description: label: Browser; type: enum; required: true; default: Chromium; options: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit; disabled while a test is in progress

actions.action: Indicate whether to run in headless mode
actions.description: label: Run in headless mode; type: boolean; required: false; default: false; when false the browser window is visible to the user; disabled while a test is in progress

actions.action: Indicate whether to show the authentication section
actions.description: Show/Hide control next to the Authentication section header; type: boolean; default: shown; sets the authentication section visibility; when hidden OIDC fields are not shown but their state is preserved

actions.action: Enter the OIDC Key
actions.description: label: OIDC Key; type: text; required: false; placeholder: oidc.user:...; format: OIDC session key found in browser DevTools > Application > Session storage; disabled when authentication section is hidden or test is in progress

actions.action: Provide the OIDC Value
actions.description: label: OIDC Value (JSON); type: JSON text area; required: false; placeholder: {id_token: ...}; validation: must be valid JSON if provided; error: Invalid JSON for OIDC value. Please fix it before running the test.; disabled when authentication section is hidden or test is in progress

actions.action: Indicate whether to mask the OIDC value
actions.description: label: Mask OIDC value; type: boolean; required: false; default: false; when true the OIDC Value text area is replaced with a bullet-character placeholder and a Reveal control appears to restore the editable view; disabled when authentication section is hidden

actions.action: Submit the test run to the server
actions.description: Triggers POST /api/run-test with testScenario, browser, headless, oidcKey (optional), oidcValue as parsed JSON object (optional). Validates OIDC JSON before calling the endpoint; aborts with an error log entry if JSON is invalid. Control is disabled while a test is already in progress.

apis.request: { testScenario: string, browser: string, headless: boolean, oidcKey?: string, oidcValue?: object }
apis.response: { success: boolean, logs: string[], reportAvailable: boolean, customReportAvailable: boolean, customReportPath: string|null, error?: string }

actions.action: Observe the run status indicator
actions.description: Status badge displayed in the Live Test Logs header; values: IDLE (gray), RUNNING (amber), PASSED (green), FAILED (red), STOPPED (red)

actions.action: Review the active test context summary
actions.description: Displays the selected scenario name, browser name, and headless/headed mode as a summary line below the Live Test Logs header

actions.action: Review the live log entries as they appear
actions.description: Log display streams timestamped entries from the server response; auto-scrolls to the most recent entry; shows Running — logs will appear here... while in progress, or No test logs yet. Configure and run a test to begin. when idle

actions.action: Poll the server for current run status
actions.description: Automatic background request every 3 seconds while testInProgress is true; updates customReportAvailable and resets the run state when the server signals completion (testRunInProgress: false in response)

apis.response: { testRunInProgress: boolean, currentChildPid: number|null, customReportAvailable: boolean, customReportPath: string|null }

steps.step: Access the test report after run completion

actions.action: Observe the report availability state
actions.description: Reporting section shows one of four states after processCompleted is true: (1) custom report available — View Custom Report shown; (2) Playwright report available but no custom — Download Playwright Report shown; (3) testFailed with no report — No report found due to script failure.; (4) default — No report available for this run. Before first run: Run a test to generate a report.

actions.action: Open the custom test report
actions.description: Opens GET /api/tests/custom-report in a new browser window; available only when customReportAvailable is true; serves the most recently generated HealingReporter HTML report from custom-reports/report-{timestamp}.html

actions.action: Open the Playwright HTML test report
actions.description: Opens GET /api/tests/report in a new browser window; available when reportAvailable is true but customReportAvailable is false; serves playwright-report/index.html

scenarios.scenario: Launch a localhost sanity test run
scenarios.description: QA Engineer selects Breezeai sanity localhost as the test scenario and provides a localhost URL. The server generates a copy of the dev sanity spec with the dev URL replaced by the provided localhost URL and executes it without OIDC authentication.

steps.step: Specify test configuration for localhost mode

actions.action: Select the test scenario
actions.description: label: Test Scenario; type: enum; required: true; must be set to Breezeai sanity localhost to activate localhost mode and reveal the Localhost URL field; all other scenario options run in authenticated mode

actions.action: Select the browser
actions.description: label: Browser; type: enum; required: true; default: Chromium; options: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit; disabled while a test is in progress

actions.action: Indicate whether to run in headless mode
actions.description: label: Run in headless mode; type: boolean; required: false; default: false; when false the browser window is visible; disabled while a test is in progress

actions.action: Enter the localhost URL
actions.description: label: Localhost URL; type: text; required: false; default: http://localhost:5173; placeholder: http://localhost:5173; validation: must be a valid URL with http or https protocol; error: Enter a valid localhost URL, e.g. http://localhost:5173; visible only when testScenario equals Breezeai sanity localhost

actions.action: Submit the localhost test run to the server
actions.description: Triggers POST /api/run-test with isLocalhost: true and the provided localhostUrl; URL is validated on the client before calling the endpoint; server generates a copy of the dev sanity spec replacing the dev URL with the localhost URL; OIDC authentication is not required

apis.request: { testScenario: string, browser: string, headless: boolean, isLocalhost: true, localhostUrl: string }
apis.response: { success: boolean, logs: string[], reportAvailable: boolean, customReportAvailable: boolean, customReportPath: string|null, error?: string }

actions.action: Observe the run status indicator
actions.description: Status badge in the Live Test Logs header; values: IDLE (gray), RUNNING (amber), PASSED (green), FAILED (red), STOPPED (red)

actions.action: Review the live log entries as they appear
actions.description: Log display streams timestamped entries from the server response and auto-scrolls to the most recent entry

actions.action: Poll the server for current run status
actions.description: Automatic background request every 3 seconds while testInProgress is true; updates customReportAvailable and resets run state when the server signals completion

apis.response: { testRunInProgress: boolean, currentChildPid: number|null, customReportAvailable: boolean, customReportPath: string|null }

steps.step: Access the test report after run completion

actions.action: Observe the report availability state
actions.description: Reporting section shows one of four states after processCompleted is true: (1) custom report available — View Custom Report shown; (2) Playwright report available but no custom — Download Playwright Report shown; (3) testFailed with no report — No report found due to script failure.; (4) default — No report available for this run. Before first run: Run a test to generate a report.

actions.action: Open the custom test report
actions.description: Opens GET /api/tests/custom-report in a new browser window; available only when customReportAvailable is true; serves the most recently generated HealingReporter HTML report from custom-reports/report-{timestamp}.html

actions.action: Open the Playwright HTML test report
actions.description: Opens GET /api/tests/report in a new browser window; available when reportAvailable is true but customReportAvailable is false; serves playwright-report/index.html

scenarios.scenario: Stop a test run during execution
scenarios.description: QA Engineer requests the server to stop an in-progress test run. The user must confirm intent before the stop signal is sent. The server terminates the test process tree and the UI transitions to a STOPPED state.

actions.action: Confirm the intent to stop the running test
actions.description: A browser confirmation prompt asks: Stop test execution? This will attempt to cancel the running test.; QA Engineer must confirm to proceed; cancelling aborts the stop flow; the Stop control is disabled when no test is in progress

actions.action: Submit the stop signal to the server
actions.description: Sends POST /api/stop-test; server attempts to terminate the running test process tree; also aborts the in-flight fetch request via AbortController; notification shows Stopping test... then updates with server confirmation or error

scenarios.scenario: Force-reset stale run state on the server
scenarios.description: QA Engineer forces a reset of the server run state when a test is stuck or the dashboard is in an inconsistent state. The server kills any running child process and clears the in-progress flag.

actions.action: Confirm the intent to reset the server run state
actions.description: A browser confirmation prompt asks: Reset run state on server? This will attempt to kill any running test and clear UI state.; QA Engineer must confirm to proceed; cancelling aborts the reset

actions.action: Submit the run state reset to the server
actions.description: Sends POST /api/reset-run; server kills any running child process and sets testRunInProgress to false; UI resets to STOPPED state and logs Run state reset on server via user action

outcomes.description: Persist OIDC session credentials into the server-side global-setup.js to enable authenticated test runs without re-entering credentials each session.

scenarios.scenario: Persist OIDC session credentials to the server
scenarios.description: QA Engineer enters the OIDC Key and OIDC Value JSON extracted from browser DevTools, confirms a security warning about permanent file modification, and saves the credentials to global-setup.js on the server. A timestamped backup of the existing file is created automatically before the write.

actions.action: Enter the OIDC Key
actions.description: label: OIDC Key; type: text; required: true for save; placeholder: oidc.user:...; format: OIDC session key found in browser DevTools > Application > Session storage; error if empty: Provide both OIDC Key and OIDC Value before saving.

actions.action: Provide the OIDC Value
actions.description: label: OIDC Value (JSON); type: JSON text area; required: true for save; must be valid JSON; validation: JSON.parse check before save; error: OIDC value must be valid JSON. Fix it before saving.; disabled when test is in progress

actions.action: Confirm the intent to write sensitive OIDC data to the server
actions.description: A browser confirmation prompt warns: Security warning: this will write sensitive OIDC data into global-setup.js on the server (a permanent file change). Do you want to proceed?; QA Engineer must confirm; cancelling aborts the save

actions.action: Submit the OIDC credentials to the server
actions.description: Sends POST /api/save-oidc with oidcKey (string) and oidcValue (parsed JSON object); server writes values into global-setup.js and creates a timestamped backup (.bak.{timestamp}); notification shows Saving OIDC to server (creating a backup)... then OIDC saved to global-setup.js (backup created). on success

apis.response: { success: true, backup: string } | { error: string }
